summary.goal: When the planning agent modifies the plan via MCP tools, the UI automatically reflects those changes without requiring a page reload
summary.context: Currently, agent calls MCP → database updates → UI shows stale data. User must manually reload to see agent's work. This breaks the collaborative feel of AI-assisted planning.
in_scope: SSE endpoint for plan change events
UI subscription when AI is connected
Automatic plan data refresh on change events
Version conflict handling (UI shows newer version)
out_of_scope: Full collaborative editing (multiple humans editing simultaneously)
Granular field-level updates (full plan refresh is fine for MVP)
WebSocket upgrade (SSE is sufficient for one-way server→client)

acceptance_criteria.description: Backend emits SSE event when plan version changes (step added/edited/removed)
UI subscribes to SSE stream when connectionStatus === 'connected'
UI automatically fetches fresh plan data when change event received
UI handles version conflicts gracefully (newer version replaces local state)
SSE connection closes when leaving plan editor page
SSE reconnects automatically if connection drops while on page

plan_implementation.approach: SSE-based one-way sync from backend to frontend. Backend emits events when plan changes, UI subscribes when agent is connected.

steps.title: Create plan event emitter module
steps.description: Create src/events/plan-events.ts with EventEmitter for plan changes. Exports: emitPlanChange(planId, version, changeType), onPlanChange(planId, callback), offPlanChange(planId, callback).

acceptance_criteria.description: emitPlanChange(planId, version, changeType) broadcasts to listeners for that planId
changeType is 'step_added' | 'step_edited' | 'step_removed' | 'criteria_added' | 'criteria_edited'
Multiple listeners per planId supported
offPlanChange removes specific listener

steps.title: Hook plan-operations to emit events
steps.description: Update src/domain/plan-operations.ts to call emitPlanChange after successful modifications. Affects: addStepToPlan, editStepInPlan, removeStepFromPlan, addCriteriaToStep, editCriteriaInStep.

acceptance_criteria.description: addStepToPlan emits { planId, version, changeType: 'step_added', stepId }
editStepInPlan emits { planId, version, changeType: 'step_edited', stepId }
removeStepFromPlan emits { planId, version, changeType: 'step_removed', stepId }
Events only emitted on success (result.success === true)

steps.title: Create SSE endpoint for plan events

acceptance_criteria.description: Response Content-Type is 'text/event-stream'
Connection kept alive with periodic ':keepalive' comments (every 30s)
Returns 404 if plan doesn't exist
Cleans up listener on client disconnect (req.on('close'))

steps.title: Add SSE route to Express app
steps.description: Register the events endpoint in src/api/routes.ts.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /plans/:id/events route registered
Route uses createEventsHandler(storage)

steps.title: Create usePlanEvents hook
steps.description: Create packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/usePlanEvents.ts. Manages EventSource lifecycle, reconnection, and event callbacks.

acceptance_criteria.description: usePlanEvents(planId, enabled, onEvent) signature
Creates EventSource to /api/plans/:id/events when enabled=true
Calls onEvent(data) when 'plan_change' event received
Closes EventSource when enabled becomes false or component unmounts
Auto-reconnects on error after 3 second delay (max 5 retries)
Returns { isConnected: boolean, error: string | null }

steps.title: Integrate usePlanEvents into PlanEditorPage
steps.description: Update packages/planner-ui/src/pages/PlanEditorPage.tsx to subscribe to plan events when AI is connected. On event, refetch plan data with debounce.

acceptance_criteria.description: usePlanEvents called with enabled = (connectionStatus === 'connected')
onEvent callback triggers refetch of plan data
Refetch is debounced (300ms) to handle rapid events
If fetched version > local version, state is updated
If fetched version <= local version, no-op (local is current)

steps.title: Add backend integration tests
steps.description: Add tests in src/api/events.test.ts for SSE endpoint and event emission.

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: SSE endpoint returns 404 for non-existent plan
Test: Adding step via MCP tool emits event to SSE client
Test: Event data includes version, changeType, stepId
Test: Client disconnect removes listener (no memory leak)

steps.title: Add frontend unit tests
steps.description: Add tests for usePlanEvents hook with mocked EventSource.

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: Hook creates EventSource when enabled=true
Test: Hook closes EventSource when enabled becomes false
Test: Hook calls onEvent when message received
Test: Hook auto-reconnects after error

cases.description: emitPlanChange broadcasts to all listeners for planId
offPlanChange removes specific listener without affecting others
addStepToPlan emits step_added event with stepId
editStepInPlan emits step_edited event with stepId
removeStepFromPlan emits step_removed event with stepId
usePlanEvents calls onEvent callback when message received
onEvent triggers refetch and updates state if version > local
Failed operations do not emit events (success check)
SSE client disconnect removes listener (no memory leak)
usePlanEvents closes EventSource when enabled becomes false
Multiple rapid events debounced to single refresh (300ms)
No-op if fetched version <= local version
SSE endpoint returns 404 for non-existent plan

data_requirements: Test plan with 2+ existing steps (for edit/remove scenarios)
Storage mock that tracks emitted events
Mock EventSource class for frontend hook tests
plan_tests.notes: Moderate coverage - integration tests for backend (event emitter + SSE endpoint), unit tests with mocked EventSource for frontend hook. Skip E2E browser tests.
